name: Message Function 47 Code
definition: Type of message supporting a service.

FAUQ.name: Financial Authorisation Request
FAUQ.definition: Request for authorisation with financial capture.

CMPV.name: Completion Advice
CMPV.definition: Advice for completion without financial capture.

BTCH.name: Batch Transfer
BTCH.definition: Transfer the financial data as a collection of transction.

FRVA.name: Financial Reversal Advice
FRVA.definition: Advice for reversal with financial capture.

AUTQ.name: Authorisation Request
AUTQ.definition: The initiator requests an authorisation without financial impact to complete the transaction.

FCMV.name: Financial Completion Advice
FCMV.definition: Advice for completion with financial capture.

RVRA.name: Reversal Advice
RVRA.definition: Advice for reversal without financial capture.

NFRQ.name: Non Financial Request
NFRQ.definition: Initiator of the message requests additional information to the receiver.

TRPQ.name: Transaction Report Request
TRPQ.definition: Request to receive of a report of transaction from the issuer to the receiver.

ATAF.name: Acceptor To Acquirer Batch File Exchange
ATAF.definition: Concatenation of multiple exchanges in one file.
